content: Jon Naan Igunẽdiya Tamo Ula Gudũ Fen
Sain anĩ bun, Galili nẽ uyu irouya Herod Jesus nigin od karĩ ye fen,
in kabĩ tamo irokenẽdin, “Enĩ Jon naan igunẽdiya tamo, ĩ laa fen anĩ kel fã yen! Anĩ nigin, memelik nẽ totol ĩ bun kabĩ yalef.”
Kulu Herod, in tura Filip nẽ aiwa, Herodias nigin, Jon yale ifõ, kalabus bun inenen.
Ere nigin, Jon ĩ irokenẽdig, “Õ ĩtãfiya ufodul ken, turã nẽ kayau walen.”
Herod Jon yukesiya nigin wau yenen, anĩ ere, tamo kayau kumĩ fedin, ere nigin, idi ĩ profet taka dedig.
Herod sina gõ fen anĩ nẽ naa bun, Herodias nẽ barai seg kui ye fen, dole kenẽdi di, Herod wau al bagai fen.
Age fe di, ĩ wau adok kuturol fen, ne barai ereb taka nigin to fouf, de anĩ bagai ifenẽf yen.
In sinam weder te yabi di, ĩ iron, “Beĩ taka bun Jon naan igunẽdiya tamo mudur uno fen, ein wanauf.”
King ĩ wau togun, anĩ ere, wau kuturol fen, tamo kayau meleid bun kurõ fesin anĩ nigin, in oroya dõf anĩ bagai ifenẽf nigin wogõ ye fen, tamo sur fe di,
Jon kalabus bun ula gudũ fen.
In mudur beĩ bun dino diroule, ne barai difenẽ di, ĩ sina gein irou ilen.
Jon nẽ dõ fiya tar disi, in bouwa buru dale mũ difen. Age de fen, idi dilen, Jesus dirokenen.
Jesus Faif Tausen Tamo Saaf Ifenẽdin
Jesus, Herod Jon ula gudũ fen anĩ karĩ ye fen, ĩ mugu bagai waag bun moilin ilen. Tamo kayau idi anĩ karĩ de fen, taun temeleid yedim dõ difen.
Sain Jesus kutũ yeis fen, mala iran, tamo kayau musei iledin, ĩ idi nigin wau yu ken, idi neid dagi el fiyẽdin.
Mogo bok isi di, in dõ fiya tar Jesus wagen disi diron, “Eĩ gerere tuan, sain mogo sa kelef. Tamo kayau susur wo di, dilalauf, ago di, idi fonõ fonõ dile fen, dogo neid saaf na dalouf.”
Jesus irokenẽdin, “Idi ileya nigin kisi to yenẽf. Saaf yõya nigin ãgem wenẽdigouf.”
Idi dirokenen, “Amã ein bret faif, gau uru ado dogol.”
Ĩ iron, “Wageun gurig urousig.”

Tamo kayau fisir bun dibodadãf nigin Jesus irokenẽdin. Bret faif gau uru ado, imam yale, saa ilun itad fen, ĩ Negur de fiye ken, bret mumã fen. Agef fen, in dõ fiya tar ifenẽdi di, idim tamo kayau difenẽdin.
Idi ganan don anĩ kisi felen. Age fe di, in dõ fiya tar, tamo kayau bret dokon, tunĩ ditoraran anĩ fito difen, karam tuwelf eweid gere fen.
Tamo bret don anĩ, idi faif tausen age fiya, kayau kesu geid iwesediya sã.
Jesus Naan Teteatu Iyon
Kaisã bagai, Jesus, in dõ fiya tar waag bun idi ketem sitakã dilauf nigin sur fedin. Age de mog, ĩ tamo kayau irudin.
Jesus idi irud le fen, ĩ yogo arein kosẽ youf nigin iselen. Ĩ an mugu ibod mog, bõ irou isin.
Anĩ ere, waag mogo teneub itoron gerõ ifaren, yau odug fã ye di, moloun wĩ ye fen, waag yũ di, ilef isif fen.
Wef mog, Jesus daliyou teteatu idi gedin iyok ilen.
Sain in dõ fiya tar meleid diran, daliyou teteatu iyõ mog, dile fen, idi tererẽ den. Idi diron, “Eĩ baraũ,” kumĩ de fen, ui guru den.
Anĩ ere, kaisã bagai Jesus irokenẽdin, “Totol ufareg! Are ayam. To kumĩ wog.”
Pita solof iron, “Odug, onom ouf are, urokana len, naan teteatu õ garan asiyouf.”
Jesus iron, “Usi.” Age fiyẽ di, Pita waag bun kutũ yeis, naan teteatu Jesus wagen iyok ilen.
Anĩ ere, ĩ yau ile fen, kumĩ ye di, gamai imutuk isil fen, iweig iron, “Odug, usenna!”
Kaisã bagai, Jesus ima iran, yalesne ken, irokenen, “Õ momoiya naal, ere nigin õ waũ uru ado?”
Age ye fen, idi uru waag namen sosõ de di, yau kee relen.
Anĩ dile fen, idi waag namen difaren, Jesus nigin seli dabi diron, “Momoi bagai, õ anĩ Negur Naal.”
Jesus Genesaret Oun Dagi Adodo El Fedin
Sain idi daliyou sitakã dibal dilen, Genesaret teneub bun wõ den.
Tamo kayau fonõ anĩ bun temeleid, Jesus kelei ken, idi fonõ anĩ kalilĩ fiya fõ fõ ganan od dinon. Fonõ fonõ idi neid dagi tamo guri difeid, Jesus wagen disi fen,
idi dagi tamo yogon gabar irig kobũ difouf nigin, Jesus digonen. Ganan idi ĩ kobũ difen, dagi fara feledin.
